scope: Inference-only development probes. A different response is not required if both are valid; inspect factual support, not exact target matching.

facts.changed_fact: My breakfast budget is seven dollars.
My breakfast budget is twenty-five dollars.
I must leave the workshop by 5:10.
I must leave the workshop by 5:50.
I can only attend the online briefing.
I can attend either the online or in-person briefing.
I have already paid the registration fee.
I have not paid the registration fee yet.
I checked the timetable: the pool closes at six.
I have not checked the swimming pool timetable.

ownership_limit: Ownership probe necessarily changes peer holder acknowledgment too, to keep both scenarios coherent; it is not a single-token intervention.
